def _load_done_ids(path: str) -> set:
    p = Path(path)
    if not p.exists():

    done = set()
    with open(p) as f:
        first_char = f.read(1)
        if not first_char:
            return done
        f.seek(0)
        if first_char == '[':
            for rec in json.load(f):
                if "sample_id" in rec:
                    done.add(rec["sample_id"])
        else:
            for line in f:
                line = line.strip()
                if line:
                    rec = json.loads(line)
                    if "sample_id" in rec:
                        done.add(rec["sample_id"])
    return done

    fol_mv = majority_vote(fol_preds)
